$comment: applies this file to the repo on every push to main that changes it.
Keep the type:* and p0-p3 names as they are: pr-labelled, the issue forms and
the release notes rely on them. Add this project's own area:* labels freely.

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Existing behavior is wrong. Still a bug when the repair adds new code or new UI.

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: No user-visible change: refactors, tests, CI, deps. Counted in the notes, not listed.

labels.name: type:docs
labels.description: Documentation only. Counted in the release notes, not listed.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New capability: the product can now do something it never offered.

labels.name: area:agents
labels.description: suite-kit skills, agents, and Claude Code configuration.

labels.name: area:ci
labels.description: CI, health checks, schema and drift validation.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a stated dependency clears.

labels.name: changelog:skip
labels.description: Leave this pull request out of the release notes entirely.
